title: PAD 03 — CAMERA TOO NEAR, PAD STILL FULLY VISIBLE
bug: Old path: the 8–20 m range check rejected a 4.8 m view even though the pad centre was visible and 100% of the pad pattern was in frame.
fix: Close range is not a rejection by itself. The pad is fully visible and the centre is resolvable, so the far-limit check admits it; clipped or overfilled pads still fail R013.

before.rule_error: R012: pad range 4.80 m is outside 8-20 m
